examples.en: What else do you have in your pocket?
I don't have any money in my pockets.

examples.text: La chiave è nella mia tasca.
examples.en: The key is in my pocket.

examples.text: Ha cercato la chiave nelle sue tasche.
examples.en: He searched his pockets for the key.

examples.text: Si metta i soldi in tasca.
examples.en: Put the money in your pocket.
